# Third-party notices for rclnodejs

`rclnodejs 2.2.0` is Apache-2.0, but its bundled `third_party/ref-napi/lib/ref.js` contains MIT-licensed code from ref-napi. Distributions containing rclnodejs must also include [ref-napi.LICENSE](ref-napi.LICENSE).

The authoritative notice is the [upstream ref-napi LICENSE](https://github.com/node-ffi-napi/ref-napi/blob/latest/LICENSE). Preserve the notices for other npm dependencies, ROS, and operating-system components according to their respective distribution terms.
